method.comparison: Same current incremental product for both variants. Rebuild both daily tables with identical columns, composite PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL and two existing explicit date/project indexes; only remove WITHOUT ROWID for rowid. Implicit rowid adds no application column; composite PK becomes a separate UNIQUE index. No extra session index.
method.preparation: Read-only source backup, deterministic synthetic seed, same frozen snapshot per dataset. Both layouts copied in composite-PK order, VACUUM and ANALYZE before measurement. Separate sequential process per variant/pair; order alternates. Source remains read-only in workers.
method.writes: Actual replaceSessions BEGIN IMMEDIATE through COMMIT. Before each sparse case restore original selected session once. Checkpoint TRUNCATE before timing. Full-reapply restores the preceding deleted request and compares all input. Input preparation, verification and checkpoint excluded; streamed full input consumption included.
method.reads: Initial identical snapshot before mutations. Public queryUsagePage rows+COUNT limit 100, plus separately prepared rows and COUNT times. Three preparation calls then 5 or configured samples, 1..20 iterations chosen to target 5 ms per sample. All-month has no date filter; one-month uses busiest calendar month range with unknownTime=exclude. Warm cache only.
method.replay: Separately timed full daily snapshot DELETE/INSERT transaction; one warmup and three repeats. This is not a request update or an isolated incremental-rollup timing.
method.resources: Main object pages from dbstat at compact initial state and after mutations. File bytes/free pages separate; WAL is post-operation file length after pre-operation TRUNCATE, not total device I/O. RSS/heap and lifetime peak include fixture/verification/runtime; no isolated allocation claim.
method.correctness: First WITHOUT ROWID process per dataset checks all 5 groupings x provider/model and all read filters against independent raw SQL before/after every mutation. All workers compare complete fact/ID hashes, all aggregate groups, ordered daily-state hashes and read-filter result hashes. Float aggregates normalized to 10 significant digits; raw averages/cost tolerance 1e-9. FK check each state and final integrity_check.
method.excludes: No live DB writes, product schema migration, JSONL scanning/parsing, quota, IPC/UI latency, cold I/O or measured read/write production-frequency mix.
